transformToUVY.method: NONE ACCEPTED. Provisional b-class placement only (sfm/provisional.json): gravity from plumb (even VP frames) + left wall at the escalator foot taken as the March office-frontage line (a-failed plane) + lane camera 000258 placed in the MainShell GATE1 door opening + floor layer at Y=0. Exactly determined; no redundancy.
transformToUVY.formula: ENU = scale*rotation*SfM + translation (rotation proper); Unity = (ENU.x, ENU.z, ENU.y); UVY from Unity (U = x sin16.2 + z cos16.2, V = x cos16.2 - z sin16.2, Y = y). Equivalent direct form sfm/provisional.json:uvy (UVY is left-handed w.r.t. ENU, so that 3x3 has det -1).
